craft_notes: Sthāyin: parokṣa-dīkṣā unit 40. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 8. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: In the body of darbha and the rest, offered into the fire of mantra together with full, freed from bonds goes to Śiva, free from return again.
l4.sanskrit_cite: dārbhādidehe mantrāgnāvarpite pūrṇayā saha muktapāśaḥ śivaṃ yāti punarāvṛttivarjitaḥ
